nodes.text: Unlike SARS-CoV-2, #HMPV is not a novel virus, says @MenonBioPhysics in an interview as #HMPV cases get reported. It has been in circulation for several decades now and it is likely that some or most of us have been exposed to it before. Read on: https://t.co/agulCQA0Qh
